luau_snippet:
-- run in the Studio command bar after pasting the JSON into a ModuleScript 'GrimeTestPatch' (returns HttpService:JSONDecode(json)) and uploading the PNGs; fill IDS[texture] with the asset ids.
local P = require(workspace.GrimeTestPatch); local IDS = {} -- IDS['W_MossBase_A'] = 'rbxassetid://...'
local root = workspace.HalloweenDecor:FindFirstChild('Grime') or Instance.new('Folder', workspace.HalloweenDecor); root.Name = 'Grime'
local tp = Instance.new('Folder'); tp.Name = 'TestPatch'; tp.Parent = root
local function make(e) local p = Instance.new('Part'); p.Name = e.name
  for k, v in pairs(e.part) do if k == 'Material' then p.Material = Enum.Material[v] else p[k] = v end end
  p.Size = Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.size))
  p.CFrame = CFrame.new(table.unpack(e.position)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(e.rotation_y_deg), 0)
  local d = Instance.new(e.kind == 'Texture' and 'Texture' or 'Decal'); d.Face = Enum.NormalId[e.face]
  d.Texture = IDS[e.texture] or ''
  for k, v in pairs(e.texture_props or {}) do d[k] = v end
  for k, v in pairs(e.decal or {}) do d[k] = v end
  d.Parent = p; p.Parent = tp end
for _, e in ipairs(P.wall) do make(e) end; for _, e in ipairs(P.floor) do make(e) end
workspace.GrimeTestPatch:Destroy() -- the ModuleScript is not needed once the parts exist
